description: This file defines a React functional component for editing guardrail configurations in a UI. It includes form elements, state management, data fetching, and submit logic for updating guardrails.

methods.name: handleProviderChange
methods.description: Handles change in selected guardrail provider, resetting relevant form fields and state.

methods.name: handleEntitySelect
methods.description: Toggles selection of an entity for PII configuration.

methods.name: handleActionSelect
methods.description: Sets the action for a specific entity within PII configuration.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Validates form inputs, constructs the guardrail update payload, and sends a PUT request to update the guardrail configuration.

methods.name: renderPiiConfiguration
methods.description: Renders the PII configuration component if applicable.

methods.name: renderProviderSpecificFields
methods.description: Renders provider-specific configuration input fields based on the selected provider.
